newsitem.title: USA: FirstCity, Harbor Financial to merge.
newsitem.headline: FirstCity, Harbor Financial to merge.

text.p: FirstCity Financial Corp said Wednesday that it and Harbor Financial Group Inc have definitively agreed to merge. FirstCity said it will issue 1,581,000 shares of its common stock in exchange for 100 percent of the outstanding capital stock of Harbor.
FirstCity shares closed Wednesday down 1-1/4 at 23.
FirstCity said the agreement is subject to approval by both companies' shareholders and regulatory agencies. FirstCity shareholders are scheduled to vote on the merger at its annual meeting May 15.
The deal is expected to close before mid year.
The merger will be treated as a pooling of interests and will make Harbor a subsidiary of FirstCity Financial, FirstCity said.
Harbor is the parent of Houston-based Harbor Financial Mortgage Corp and Dallas-based New American Financial Inc, both mortgage banking companies.
